_help: Act 3, after -2d's road ambush: recognized_bandits (Acts 4 and 5 remember these men), companion reactions, and with ambush_prisoners a hired man names the Veil (keepers_named). Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act3.py.

start.speaker: player
start.line: The shooting's stopped. Dust still hanging over the wadi.

r_hargreaves.speaker: hargreaves
r_hargreaves.line: High ground, a choke point, a second wave on horseback. That wasn't bandits on the off chance. Somebody planned it.

r_isabelle.speaker: isabelle
r_isabelle.line: Hired guns first, then the real ones. Whoever they are, they wanted to see what we'd do.

r_idris.speaker: idris
r_idris.line: Bandits do not ride away from loot. These ones did. I do not like that.

r_saleh.speaker: saleh
r_saleh.line: Riders in dark robes who take nothing. I have heard of such men. I did not believe it.

ask_prisoner.speaker: player
ask_prisoner.line: One of the hired men is still alive, hands up behind a rock.

choices.label: Threaten him
choices.line: Talk, or I leave you here for the vultures.

answer.speaker: player
answer.line: Gold, he says, from a man with a jackal ring. The riders were not his friends. 'They belong to the Veil,' he says, and won't say another word.

hassan_line.speaker: hassan
hassan_line.line: They wanted us to turn back. Not to die. There is a difference, if you look for it.
